title: The Complex Relationship Between Sleep Quality and Job Satisfaction: A Machine Learning-Based Bayesian Rule Set Algorithm.
summary: Bayesian rule set analyzes CGSS survey variables and interactions; Methods identifies the 618 observations and algorithm. Results identifies combinations of sleep quality, autonomy, hours and satisfaction; evidence is associational survey analysis. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
